findings: 64 of the 74 Wakefield Trinity cards on this list are for players who never played for Wakefield. Almost all of them were Warrington players (Mark Forster, Lee Penny, Mark Hilton, Toa Kohe-Love, Stefan Ratchford and others), so a batch of Warrington players seems to have been imported under Wakefield. Where that applies, each fix has likelyIntendedClub with the Warrington seasons, a representative year and that season's appearances. The cards for Ben Harrison, Kevin Penny, Danny Halliwell and Nathan Wood have a real but minor Wakefield spell, so the Wakefield year is given and the Warrington alternative is also listed.
For Martin Hall (PSG) and Wayne Godwin (Halifax) the player never played for the card's club; see each note.

fixes.name: Chris Hicks
fixes.note: Penrith 1997–2002, Manly 2004–07, Warrington 2008–10, Parramatta 2011; no Wakefield spell

fixes.name: Richard Henare
fixes.note: Carlisle 1995–96, Warrington 1996–97, Workington 1998, Swinton 1999–2000; no Wakefield spell

fixes.name: Wayne Godwin
fixes.note: RLP: Castleford 2001–04, Wigan 2005–06, Hull FC 2007, Bradford 2008–10, Salford 2011–13 and 2015, Dewsbury 2014–15. No Halifax seasons.

fixes.name: Jacob Fairbank
fixes.note: 2012: 7 apps (only 1–7 per season; his main club is Halifax 2015–)

fixes.name: Adrian Belle
fixes.note: 1996: 20 apps (the only Super League-era Oldham season)

fixes.name: Martin Hall
fixes.note: The Martin Hall born 1968 never played for PSG. RLP: Oldham, Rochdale, Wigan 1992–97, Castleford/Halifax 1998, Hull 1999. His Wigan 1996 season (26 apps) would be the natural card.

fixes.name: Stephen Nash
fixes.note: 2007: 10 apps, 2009: 11 apps; the 2008 count was not shown

fixes.name: Matty Dawson-Jones
fixes.note: 50 St Helens apps over 2014–16; no per-season split available, so 2015 (middle season) was picked

fixes.name: Alan Hunte
fixes.note: Played 2 games for Wakefield in 1988/89 and none from 1996.

fixes.name: Ben Harrison
fixes.note: Wakefield 2016 had only 3 apps; he was mainly a Warrington player.

fixes.name: Danny Halliwell
fixes.note: 2002: 3 apps for Wakefield (10 for Warrington the same year)

fixes.name: Kevin Penny
fixes.note: Wakefield 2011 had only 5 apps; he was mainly a Warrington player.

fixes.name: Nathan Wood
fixes.note: 2002: 14 apps for Wakefield (and 14 for Warrington); mainly a Warrington player

fixes.name: Michael McIlorum
fixes.note: Spent 2007–2017 at Wigan, then Catalans 2018–. No per-season appearance split was found (no RLP page by that name), so 2013 was picked as a representative mid-career season.
